none: PAS NLM-9FB1D8: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Crowle
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS ROMA]. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above. In exergue: [?CI]SS. Diameter:15.3mm, Weight: 1.05gms, die axis: 6
